title: Slot phasing playbook — customer tranche phasing scenarios (Jan 2028)
content:
Purpose and scope:
- Working sheet to decide contract-level GPU tranche placement and phased activations for Dedicated customers across regions for early 2028 launches.
- Focus is per-contract tranche (northstar/aurora/atlas naming) rather than global pool rebalances.
- This is a planning artifact for infra, product, and account teams to align on firm cutover dates and fallback rules.

Executive summary:
- Total pool (target fleet for Jan-Mar 2028): A100-80GB: 480 slots; H100-80GB: 320 slots; Edge T4/Tesla: 120 slots (for low-cost steady jobs).
- Allocated to existing committed contracts: 68% of A100, 55% of H100. Pipeline commitments could push utilization to 92% in worst-case.
- Phasing strategy: stagger activation windows by region and tranche; reserve 8% headroom for emergency failover and burst.

Region / GPU matrix (planned active slots by tranche)
Header: region, gpu_type, tranche, reserved_slots, activation_week, target_util_pct
us-west1, A100-80GB, northstar, 120, 2028-W05, 78
us-west1, H100-80GB, aurora, 40, 2028-W10, 65
eu-west1, A100-80GB, atlas, 80, 2028-W07, 72
eu-west1, H100-80GB, northstar, 60, 2028-W08, 60
apac-southeast1, A100-80GB, aurora, 40, 2028-W12, 55
apac-southeast1, H100-80GB, atlas, 20, 2028-W14, 50

Per-contract allocation notes:
- Northstar (Enterprise launch partner): guaranteed 140 A100-equivalent slots across us-west1 + eu-west1 with nightly reserved windows 00:00-06:00 PT for training bursts. Contract SLA requires 99.5% availability on reserved slots.
- Aurora (mid-market committed): soft-reserve 80 H100-equivalent slots; can be preempted for 2 hours/day under emergency policy if infer/latency SLOs at risk.
- Atlas (startup credits converted to reserved tranche): phased 60-slot ramp over 6 weeks with telemetry gating.

Scenarios and triggers:
- Best case (supply growth + cancellations): add 120 A100 slots by Feb 2028 -> all tranches activate early; headroom stays >=15%. Action: issue activation email, update billing. Owner: Nina Park. Due: 2028-01-20.
- Likely case (on-time HW delivery, pipeline commitments hold): meet plan matrix above; headroom ~8%. Action: enable staged canaries and 2-week smoke checks. Owner: Ethan Caldwell. Due: activation weeks per matrix.
- Worst case (supply delays / overcommitments): headroom drops to <=2% and queue backlog increases >48 hours. Action: enforce preemption policy, postpone atlas final ramp, open cross-region spillover, and notify sales + legal. Owner: Marcus Leung. Escalation: INFRA-912.

Preemption and fairness rules (short):
- Preserved under SLA: northstar reserved windows and pre-scheduled training jobs.
- Preemptable: non-SLA aurora/atlas interactive compute during peak when global utilization >90%.
- Fairness algorithm: weighted round-robin across tranche buckets with weight = contract_tier_score * contract_commitment, recalculated weekly.

Operational checks before activation (checklist):
- Capacity verify: hardware serials and node health >= 98% (infra checklist).
- Network: cross-region egress budget reviewed; peering routes validated.
- Observability: route-level dashboards created, alert thresholds set (latency P95, job queue depth).
- Billing: billing mappings for tranche codes (T-NORTHSTAR, T-AURORA, T-ATLAS).

Backfill / reallocation ladder (if shortages):
1) Shift non-critical batch jobs to preemptable pool (T4) during 00:00-06:00 PT.
2) Cross-region spill to eu-west1 (if latency allowed) with 5% tax on billing rate.
3) Temporary uplift from hosted spare capacity (managed fallback): only if contract accepts fallback clause (see linked contract IDs).

Open questions for account/product:
- Should we convert 12 aurora H100 slots to A100-equivalent pool for cost parity? Pros/cons and billing impact needed.
- Are customers amenable to explicit 2-hour preemption daily window? (Sales to confirm)

Action items and owners:
- Marcus: finalize preemption policy wording and update playbook doc (due 2028-01-18).
- Ethan: create k8s/slot allocation labels and rollout canary scripts (due 2028-01-25).
- Nina: coordinate billing codes and chargeback mapping (due 2028-01-22).
- Luca: write automation to enforce weekly weighted RR quotas (prototype by 2028-02-01).

Appendix A: quick utilization calc (sample)
- us-west1 A100 pool: 160 physical slots, committed reservations total 140 -> base util = 87.5%. Allow burst headroom target 12% -> require additional 20 slots or migration.

Appendix B: linked Jira / notes
- INFRA-885: hardware arrival schedule and acceptance tests
- INFRA-912: emergency redistribution playbook (escalation path)

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally tranche-focused to make contract handoffs explicit. Expect follow-up with product and sales for billing/legal acceptance.
- Please add ticket references in comments and flag any customer objections by 2028-01-16.
